engineers: The service provider rerated the existing BB5 rather than replacing the pump or barrel. The volute nozzle and lip were cut back to enlarge the flow passage, the impellers were replaced or underfiled for the higher flow, internal bushings were resized, and one stage was removed. The nine-stage rerate met 1,628 gpm at 3,450 ft while retaining the barrel and footprint. The reported simple payback was 35 days.
source: Sulzer, Reviving Pump Performance (2020), engineering solution and outcome sections
